reason: ^SSH suite not ported to the native sshd fixture \(#5176\)$
why: SSH suites not (yet) marked native_sshd for this OS: they control the server (SshServerControl), need GNU tools or a POSIX remote shell (Windows' is cmd.exe), deploy an agent, or need host stats the app only reads from Linux /proc (macOS host monitoring, see the follow-up). Counted from the skips of the 2026-11-11 develop nightly (dispatch 43006910579) against the native_sshd markers (#5176).
